messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need help figuring out my savings interest. I have a Gold savings account with about $96,000 and I only got $450 in interest last month. That seems really low. I have multiple checking accounts and credit cards with you, and I want to make sure I’m getting the best rates.

Thanks — I can help. A few quick things up front that explain why $450 might be lower than you expect, and then next steps so I can check your specific accounts.

What I can tell you now (from our policies):
- Savings interest compounds daily and is credited monthly, so monthly credits reflect daily accrual over that month.
- Linked checking account APY boosts do NOT stack: if you have multiple checking accounts that qualify to boost your Gold savings, only the single highest checking-account boost is applied.
- Credit-card APY bonuses also do NOT stack: only the single highest card bonus is applied. Card bonuses do stack with a checking-account boost (so you can get one checking boost + one card bonus + any relationship or tier bonuses).
- For Gold savings specifically, eligible credit-card bonuses include (examples from policy): Bronze +0.15%, Silver +0.2%, Gold +0.025%, Platinum +0.15%, Diamond Elite +0.3%, EcoCard +0.6%, Green Rewards +0.35%, Crypto-Cash Back +0% — only the highest applicable bonus would apply to your Gold Account.
- If an incorrect APY boost or tier was applied, we can apply an interest correction credit and then submit an investigation report to fix the underlying issue.

To proceed and check exactly what happened for your account, I’ll need to look up your accounts and interest posting. Because that accesses your account data, I first need to verify your identity. Per our process I only need you to confirm 2 of the following 4 items: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. Which two will you provide? (Or let me know if you prefer I walk you through an estimate instead of accessing your account.)

If you’d rather not verify now, I can also:
- Walk you through a quick estimate of expected monthly interest if you tell me the APY you think applies (or I can show how to calculate it from an APY).
- Explain ways to maximize your effective APY (link a qualifying checking account, hold a card that gives the highest card bonus, or consider account tiers/relationship bonuses).

Which would you like to do?

Sure — let’s verify so you can check what actually applied.
